info.title: Crime Junkie Podcast Universal API
info.description: Access the public Crime Junkie Podcast RSS feed and WordPress JSON API to read episodes, posts, pages, media, taxonomies, authors, and site metadata from the official site.

get.description: Retrieves recent podcast episodes from Crime Junkie Podcast.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

categories.description: Episode categories exposed in the RSS item.

description.description: Episode summary or excerpt from the RSS item.

guid.description: Episode GUID from the RSS feed item.

link.description: Canonical episode URL on the official Crime Junkie site.

pubDate.description: Episode publication date from the RSS feed.

title.description: Episode title from the Crime Junkie RSS item.
